title: UI Developer
desc: Job Description: UI Developer Job Title: UI Developer Experience: 1–5 Years Job Type: Full-Time Work Mode: 100% Remote Location: United States (Remote) Job Summary We are looking for a skilled UI Developer to design, develop, and maintain responsive, user-friendly web interfaces. The ideal candidate should have strong front-end development skills, a passion for modern UI/UX design, and experience building high-quality web applications. Key Responsibilities Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces for web applications. Convert UI/UX designs and wireframes into clean, functional code. Build reusable UI components and maintain consistent design standards. Optimize web applications for performance, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility. Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and product teams. Debug issues and maintain existing front-end applications. Follow best practices for code quality, usability, and responsive design. Required Skills - HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. Responsive web design and mobile-first development. - React.js or Angular. CSS frameworks such as Bootstrap or Tailwind CSS. UI/UX design principles and Figma design handoff. - Git and version control. Cross-browser compatibility and web performance optimization. - Basic REST API integration. Experience Requirements 1–2 Years: Strong fundamentals in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive layouts. 2–3 Years: Experience building interactive interfaces and reusable components. 3–5 Years: Proficiency in modern front-end frameworks, performance optimization, and complex UI development. Preferred Qualifications Experience with TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks. Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG). Understanding of SEO-friendly front-end development. Experience with Agile development methodologies. Remote Job Locations Candidates may apply from the following US locations: 1. Austin, Texas 2. Dallas, Texas 3. Atlanta, Georgia 4. Chicago, Illinois 5. Seattle, Washington This position is fully remote; these locations represent target US hiring markets. Salary Range Estimated annual base salary: $65,000–$110,000 USD, depending on experience, technical skills, and location. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit an updated resume highlighting their UI development experience, technical skills, and relevant projects. Equal Opportunity Employer: We welcome qualified candidates from diverse backgrounds. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Product Designer
desc: Headquarters: United States - Remote Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@ tebra.com , @ patientpop.com , or @ kareo.com ) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse. We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging. About the Role We are looking for a customer-focused individual to help shape the future of our Tebra platform. This role is an exciting and challenging opportunity to be a partner in an embedded team of cross-functional counterparts. You will be joining a close-knit, collaborative product design culture with a focus on raising the bar of the day-to-day product experience for our healthcare providers and their patients. Your Area of Focus You contribute to the vision and design strategy that connects customer and business value. You have strong creative and conceptual design skills and the ability to evolve ideas that drive innovation. You have an effortless working knowledge of design fundamentals, principles, and core skills.  You build and utilize your product knowledge to navigate ambiguity, identify opportunities and define customer problem statements.  You need minimal direction on design methods and approaches to validate solutions.  You can facilitate cross-functional, collaborative ideation sessions using a variety of methods. You make proficient use of design system guidelines and contribute to components and patterns that include optimization and refinements to structural elements and patterns. You are a strong collaborator and communicator who creates understanding, drives alignment, and can work independently.   You are an effective presenter with the ability to anticipate questions and concerns, articulate a data supported point of view, synthesize and process feedback, and determine next steps. You have a working knowledge of business logic and dependencies between design, front-end development, and back-end technologies and the ability to successfully navigate the capabilities and constraints of existing technical systems. You work closely and in partnership with your product and engineering counterparts and outside of your core team inclusive of other designers, research, marketing, sales, and customer service. You can lead customer research sessions with some support and: interview customers effectively; guide the process to glean effective insights; and uncover and socialize areas of opportunity.  You possess a working understanding of various research methods, including rapid prototyping, card sorting, affinity mapping.  You are comfortable evaluating and leveraging AI tools to augment processes that result in efficiency and quality improvement. You seek out and incorporate both quantitative and qualitative data for use in reasoning and decision making. You seek out feedback and inputs from a variety of sources in order to move solutions forward, drive innovation, contribute to a connected and holistic overall experience for our customers and users, and invest in your relationships with peers and stakeholders. Your Professional Qualifications 3+ years of experience in a Product Design role (or comparable equivalent experience). Experience in B2B and/or B2C (SMB customer experience a plus; previous Healthcare a plus). Has a portfolio that demonstrates the following: Ability to deliver simplified, intuitive, and responsive user experiences for complex operations and flows (desktop web, mobile web, native app). Ability to use data insights to iterate on design solutions. Accomplished to expert level in several of the following skills: UX Design Visual User Interface Design Interaction Design Responsive Design Mobile + native mobile design Rapid Prototyping + iterative design Information Architecture Accessibility Qualitative + Quantitative data synthesis Experience working with a design system. Expert with Figma and FigJam. Proficiency in a variety of modern AI tools (such as Figma Make, Claude, Gemini, or Codex). Growth Mindset. #LI-SS1 #LI-Remote In compliance with California's pay transparency laws, the compensation range for this position will be provided and may include an hourly rate, annual salary, or On-Target Earnings (OTE), depending on the nature of the role. The specific compensation structure and detailed range will be discussed with qualified candidates during the initial talent screen. Remote Pay Range $121,500 — $143,000 USD   About Tebra Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at  www.tebra.com . Our Values Start with the Customer  We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens. Keep It Simple Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone. Stay Entrepreneurial  We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action. Better Together We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together. Celebrate Success Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success. Perks & Benefits  United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resour

title: Junior AE Benelux
desc: Headquarters: Croatia URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/jzo8hYoyQi6MffQtCgXykk/jobs-at-workmotion Junior Account Executive Benelux (Dutch-speaking) Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET) Contract type: Full-time Salary: Starting from €40,000 OTE per annum gross (60% base / 40% bonus), subject to location, skills and experience. Not Your Typical Workplace… Great talent doesn't stop at borders, and neither do the companies we work with. At WorkMotion, we're building the future of work: helping ambitious companies hire, onboard and manage the best people anywhere in the world, through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Remote-first, fast-paced, people-driven and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams beyond borders. And we're looking for people who want to win while doing it. More Than a Role The Benelux market is full of ambitious companies trapped by hiring borders. An Amsterdam scale-up has found the perfect engineer in Lisbon but doesn't know how to employ her compliantly. An Antwerp founder wants to put fresh funding into expanding to three countries by next quarter. As our Junior Account Executive Benelux, your mission is powerful: Open up the world's talent pool to Dutch, Belgian and Luxembourgish companies. This is a Junior AE role, built for a top-performer who's ready to close their own deals, not by pushing a product, but by advising with substance and closing with confidence. You're confident in front of decision-makers, curious enough to ask the questions others don't, and ambitious about your numbers: hitting target is the minimum, outperforming it is what drives you. Your energy shows in your can-do attitude and follow-through, day in, day out. Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity: Command Your Territory: Own the full sales cycle in the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg, from first conversation to onboarded talent. Curious Questioner: Ask the second and third question. Uncover where, why and how fast a company is hiring, and what's at stake if compliance goes wrong. Champion Builder: Equip your HR champion with the arguments Finance, Legal and leadership care about, so decision-makers see the value, not just the price. Deal Momentum: Create urgency, negotiate with confidence and keep deals moving. Self-Made Pipeline: Roll your sleeves up and team up with the BDRs to go after the biggest opportunities in your territory. What It Takes to Make an Impact Here: Your Background: BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS, or another target-driven, customer-facing role. You're self-driven, learn fast and know your numbers. Discovery Experience: You've led conversations to uncover a prospect's or client's needs, and you're eager to take them all the way to a signed deal. Outbound DNA: A cold call is a chance, not a threat. You know how to get a busy founder's attention, from a well-timed call after a funding round to a voice note they actually listen to. AI-Savvy & Organized: AI is a natural part of how you work, making you faster and sharper every day. And your HubSpot (or similar CRM) is always up to date. Coachable: You ask for feedback and put it into action the same day. Dutch Native: Native-level Dutch and business-fluent English. Bonus Points If You Bring Experience with HR tech, payroll, EOR or other compliance-heavy solutions. First closing experience, for example running your own demos or closing smaller deals. Creativity in getting your foot in the door: find a smart way to reach the hiring managers directly, and show them why you're the right person for this role. Not Your Typical Team: We're a team of 26 sales minds, from BDRs, AEs and Team Leads to our CRM, Sales Enablement and Campaign Manager, based across Europe, Africa and the Middle East, a motivated, fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected." We don't just work together, we push, challenge and grow together. We share what works, celebrate each other's successes, learn from every win and loss, and jump in when a colleague needs a second voice to get a deal over the line. If you're looking for an environment where your ideas are welcomed, your voice is heard, and bold strategies thrive on collective brainpower and high-energy teamwork, you'll feel right at home. The Perks of Being Here… Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours. Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day, a full day off just to recharge and relax. Get fit and stay active: Whether it's yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog, work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships. Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you'll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge. Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups! Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations. At WorkMotion, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team know at Jobs@WorkMotion.com. We're here to support you every step of the way! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/workmotion-junior-ae-benelux
